title: Generate NPC dialogue, quests, voice, music, and sound
description: A reversible, evidence-producing workflow for generate npc dialogue, quests, voice, music, and sound.

ordered_stages.action: Verify identity, voice, music, dataset, and output rights before generation.
Define state constraints, safety boundaries, quest invariants, and fallback lines.
Generate structured dialogue and audio candidates with provenance.
Check state consistency, pronunciation, peaks, loudness, duration, and loop seams.
Import approved copies and test interruption, replay, localization, and fallback behavior.

quality_gates.description: Verify rights, consent, code, weights, datasets, output terms, and generation provenance.
Validate formats and domain-specific technical constraints.
Check visual identity and temporal consistency across relevant views and frames.
Check memory, frame time, draw calls, load time, and asset budgets.
Run interaction and playability smoke tests in the target runtime.
Store screenshots, artifacts, logs, versions, and comparison evidence.
Require human approval before replacing any source or production asset.
Unlicensed identity references or voice cloning without consent block production use.
Audio peaks, loudness, loop seams, dialogue state, and quest invariants pass.

fallbacks: Use text-only dialogue or a licensed synthetic stock voice.
Use deterministic authored fallback lines when generation is unavailable.
